en: The image depicts a large, ornate building with white, arched architecture and a central entrance featuring a tall chimney or tower. The structure is surrounded by manicured gardens, pathways, and a body of water with a colonnaded, curved promenade or pier extending into it. The background shows a hilly landscape with scattered houses and a church with a pointed steeple, set under a clear blue sky. The style is reminiscent of early to mid-20th-century colorized postcards.
